prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: hit while turning left in Baytown, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported shoulder injury. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1252; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- It is not yet clear whether the injury came from this crash.
- Witnesses, photos and the other driver all confirm the accident happened as described.
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- The police and witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: Driver 1 was southbound in the left-turn lane at an intersection in Baytown, Texas, and stated that Driver 2, traveling northbound, struck the side of the vehicle as Driver 1 turned left across the opposing lane. Driver 2 confirmed this account and said the impact occurred as Driver 1 began the turn. Two independent witnesses at the scene gave statements consistent with both drivers, and photographs taken at the location show the collision in the position described. The visible damage to both vehicles is largely consistent with a side impact of this type. Driver 1 is listed as the named insured on the policy. A Passenger was seated in the front passenger seat and was identified by the responding officer and the witnesses as present in the vehicle at the time of impact. Driver 1 reported pain in the right shoulder at the scene. At this time it is not clear whether that injury resulted from this collision, and it will need to be assessed further. No prior damage to the vehicle was known to the officer or reported by either driver.
